neighbours.label: clause-ending comma or period after a complete statement of a general rule or fact in expository text
fire: Most local councils publish a development plan for their area. These plans guide new housing.
Imported goods are subject to a customs duty of 12 percent, which many traders find high.
Hernia repairs can be performed through a small incision, laparoscopically or robotically.
A kettle used for boiling water may be quite large, but it has only one spout.
Each member state must appoint a data protection authority. The authority handles complaints.
Residential buildings must be fitted with smoke alarms on every floor, according to the code.
Students who fail an exam may retake it once in the following term. Fees apply.
Pension contributions are deducted from gross salary before income tax, which lowers the bill.
